fields.name: PgSharding PostgreSQL shard-connection configuration family
fields.description: PgSharding represents a PostgreSQL shard-set collection, each set's identity and default shard, its shard connection configurations, optional set-level read/write configurations, and each shard's initialized read/write connection configurations.

members.name: PgShardSets
members.description: The provider-specific collection of shard-set connection configurations.

members.name: PgShardConnectionsConfiguration.ShardSetName
members.description: The name identifying the shard set.

members.name: PgShardConnectionsConfiguration.DefaultShardId
members.description: The default shard identifier for the shard set.

members.name: PgShardConnectionsConfiguration.Shards
members.description: The provider-specific shard connection configurations in the shard set.

members.name: PgShardConnectionsConfiguration.Read
members.description: The optional set-level read connection configuration.

members.name: PgShardConnectionsConfiguration.Write
members.description: The optional set-level write connection configuration.

members.name: PgShardConnectionConfiguration.ShardId
members.description: The shard identifier for the connection configuration.

members.name: PgShardConnectionConfiguration.ReadConnection
members.description: The initialized provider-specific read connection configuration.

members.name: PgShardConnectionConfiguration.WriteConnection
members.description: The initialized provider-specific write connection configuration.

representations.CSharp: PgShardConnectionOptions and its nested PgShardConnectionsConfiguration and PgShardConnectionConfiguration classes; the internal shared-interface views are covariant views of the provider-specific arrays and read/write objects.
